observed.description: For standard zoning lots with a lot area of 4,000 square feet or more, the residential floor area associated with any single dwelling unit may not exceed an equivalent floor area ratio of 0.60 (ZR 23-21 footnote 1). The byte-verified recapture (commit 17e8eb78) proved footnote 1 is attached to this first table row's standard value ONLY; it does NOT apply to R2X, R4, R5 or their variants. Applying this cap requires per-dwelling-unit inputs this rule does not model.

Within 100 feet of a wide street (ZR 23-22 footnote 1), a HIGHER standard-residences FAR applies: R6 3.00 (vs the conservative 2.20), R7-1 and R7-2 4.00 (vs 3.44), R8 7.20 (vs 6.02). Footnote 1 says 'or portions thereof', so a single lot can be split between the two values - a geometry computation, not a table lookup. A wide-street determination is NOT performed by this rule and the higher value is NEVER returned; the conservative (lower) value is the result and the higher value is surfaced here as a conditional alternative only.
observed.note: Always surfaced (condition null): overstating one of these lots by using the wide-street value without a wide-street determination is the single worst output this family can produce, so the higher value is never applied here.

observed.description: For R8 ONLY, the wide-street row additionally carries a qualifying affordable/senior-housing FAR of 8.64 (provenance-linked in the wide_street_qualifying_far_by_district parameter) under ZR 23-22 footnote 2, whose condition is COMPOUND - outside a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area AND within 100 feet of a wide street AND containing UAP developments or qualifying senior housing. None of those three are determined here; this value is neither applied nor emitted, only recorded as a documented limitation. Scoped to zoning_district R8 so it is not attached to R6/R7-1/R7-2 results, whose ZR 23-22 rows carry no footnote 2 (footnote-scope discipline, cf. AS-4).

meanings.builtfar: Rough existing total building area divided by tax-lot area; not established zoning floor area.
meanings.residfar: District-based standard-residence reference based on ZoneDist1, with documented fallback if that district disallows residential uses; excludes amenity bonuses. R6, R7-1, R7-2, R8 and R9 use ideal sky-exposure-plane conditions.
meanings.affresfar: District-based affordable-residence reference; does not itself establish project qualification.

scope: Table fidelity and preserved conditions; not eligibility, legal approval or complete property buildability.
